items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I had the One O'Clock Jump and Tommy had the Bugle Call Rag.

ctx.x: Both of them? Not too much. (LAUGHTER) No, that's right, because it's written down now. One O'Clock Jump, must be the first record when we started making these All Star records. I had the One O'Clock Jump and Tommy had the Bugle Call Rag. It's all written down in that book; you'll read it. He says, long as I play trombone I will never sit next to Jay C. Higginbotham and take a solo..and he had a whole quart of Grand Bad.
